title: गोलू और बंदर
beats: Morning in the village: Golu the goat, in his straw hat, munches grass under the mango tree.
A cheeky monkey on the branch above spots the hat and rubs his hands.
The monkey swings down by his tail, snatches the hat, swings back and wears it, laughing.
Golu gets angry (steam!), backs up, charges and head-butts the tree. Mangoes rain down; one bonks the monkey.
The dizzy monkey falls into the hay pile; the hat flies up and lands back on Golu's head.
The monkey sits sad with a bump. Golu feels sorry and brings him a mango. Friends!
They laugh together; the monkey sneakily tries the hat again; Golu catches him: '!' End.
